items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Oh yeah, they were street clowning. Papa and Lorenzo.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, they were street clowning. Papa and Lorenzo. They had a young fella. What was his name?
Lorenzo. Lorenzo Junior. Junior. Where did they come from? Good ones. All good ones. That's where they came from.
